heading: Wireless Network Card
bottomHtml:
It sounds like you're mentioning Wireless Network Card — are you asking for a definition, suggestions for buying one, help installing one, or something else related to it?

Just to be clear, a Wireless Network Card (also called a Wi-Fi card or wireless adapter) is a hardware device that lets your computer connect to wireless networks (Wi-Fi). It can be:

  • Internal (installed inside your laptop or desktop, usually PCIe or M.2 slot)

  • External (USB Wi-Fi adapters you can just plug in)
